spec.title: Array induction through the library method repeats the five stored results (336, 337, 346)
spec.description: The array-induction proof method moved from examples/tools/targets/array_induction.py into lib/python/jvm_array_induction.py (with the javap reader in lib/python/jvm_disassembly.py); the examples keep an adapter. Each of the five declared array contracts is proved again at this commit through the extracted method, into a scratch folder, and compared with the example's stored record of the same source: every named obligation with its expected and obtained solver answer, the cell and index widths, the class digests, the bytecode walked, the certificate's digest and the status. A step passes only when Z3 ran and the stored result is repeated. 337's caller-extra-any-length is the negative control: it must stay unresolved on 'caller read follows from the proved frame' (expected unsat, obtained sat), which the comparison counts as repeated. Nothing is written to an example.
spec.expected: Five steps exit 0, each printing 'the same result' against a stored record; the fourth also prints the one unmet obligation of the negative control.

resources.notes: All five took 7 s together when probed inline on this machine; the estimate leaves room for a cold artifact preparation.
